newsitem.title: USA: County Bank of Chesterfield, Community to merge.
newsitem.headline: County Bank of Chesterfield, Community to merge.

text.p: Community Bankshares Inc and County Bank of Chesterfield said they have signed a definitive agreement to merge.
The companies said each share of County Bank of Chesterfield will be exchanged for 1.1054 shares of Community Bankshares Inc under the deal. The merger is expected to be completed by mid-1997.
The transaction is subject to necessary regulatory and shareholder approval and is expected to close in July 1997.

Community Bankshares had 1.9 million shares outstanding, a book value of $9.54 per share at September 30, 1996 and earnings for the first nine months of 1996 of $1.17 per share. County Bank of Chesterfield, had 793,000 shares outstanding, book value of $10.46 a share and earnings for the first nine months of 1996 of $.87 per share at September 30.
Based on total assets at September 30, the transaction will increase the total assets of Community Bankshares by forty six percent to about $242 million.
